prep.summary:
Search indexing and Unicode CSV export fixes are complete and validated. Billing typing is complete, including models, invoice lines, totals, `post_entry`, explicit discount conversion, and UTC timestamps; billing tests (34), the Python suite (96), and `mypy ledgerly/billing` pass. The Go `get_user_record` → `fetch_account` rename was applied, but tag publication was not confirmed.

Test maintenance and performance improvements are complete. Shared organization, customer, invoice, and payment-method factories/fixtures, an invoice helper, rollback-oriented database sessions, and a frozen clock were introduced. The baseline is 318 passed and 4 skipped in about 15–16 seconds; invoice tests pass 46/46 and payment tests 63/63. Report fixture parameterization also succeeded.

Two invoice issues remain. `test_apply_credit_after_refund` expects 87.50 but receives 90.00, likely because credit is applied before the refund total is deducted. Fix ordering and rerun targeted invoice tests plus the broader suite.

The intermittent invoice-sync failure is race-related. Repeated execution reproduced HTTP 409 only when concurrent workers submit the same invoice. Database inspection showed the idempotency key was left as `processing` even after the original request completed successfully. `InvoiceSyncService.submit` opens a new session and forwards the key but does not persist completed responses, so inspect and fix duplicate-request/idempotency completion handling, then rerun integration and full tests.

Export log noise/reuse, settlement reconciliation, payment-failure grouping, credit-note transition ordering, and admin deletion confirmation safeguards remain future work.
